hypotheses.candidate: The connector or application reset the session
hypotheses.limitation: DEALLOCATE ALL on a direct connection produced the same 26000 on the original backend without any pool. A customer case needs evidence of which endpoint handled the request and whether sessions reset.

hypotheses.candidate: A timeout was mistaken for a pooling limitation
hypotheses.limitation: The bounded timeout control produced 57014, a different error from the 26000 recorded after the backend switch.

hypotheses.candidate: The prepared operation itself is invalid
hypotheses.limitation: The same PREPARE and EXECUTE succeeded twice on one direct backend.

hypotheses.candidate: A customer application sent this workflow through a transaction pool
hypotheses.limitation: Customer endpoint, pool mode, connector preparation method and session resets have not been observed.
